name: claude-quenching
description: OKF-centric knowledge-base aligner for the Claude Code surface of any repository. Installs one canonical Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.1) docs/ bundle, forces existing docs into conformance, inserts knowledge into the right home, curates a fixed A–Z glossary, drains project memory into docs, refactors CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md into thin pointers, imports external sources as OKF docs, parks and triages a task backlog, mints and aligns the repo's own .claude/skills + .claude/commands surface under a single taxonomy, loops it all to convergence, and drives the OpenSpec spec-driven change cycle (explore → propose → implement → sync-specs/archive) with the bundle as its knowledge substrate. Nineteen skills — eleven quenching-* plus eight openspec-* (the routing story lives in each skill's own description) — each user-invocable: false behind a thin command wrapper (/docs:* and /skill:* for quenching-*, /opsx:* for openspec-*), plus a self-contained validation hook. Every repository that adopts it looks the same.
